items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 2 May 2026 7:19am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 02 May 2026 at 7:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Largely cloudy and mainly dry with hill fog and also a risk of coastal mist at times. Then outbreaks of rain arriving later in the evening and overnight. Light south or southwest wind and a maximum temperature of 13°C.

Cloudy tomorrow with some outbreaks of rain during the morning, this tending to gradually peter out in the afternoon with bright or sunny intervals developing. Light to moderate north or northeast wind and a top temperature of 15°C.


##Outlook##

Mainly dry with bright or sunny spells on Monday. Light to moderate north or northwest wind and a highest temperature of 14°C.
